newsitem.title: USA: Mass. Gov Weld says mulls third term as governor.
newsitem.headline: Mass. Gov Weld says mulls third term as governor.

text.p: Massachusetts Gov. William Weld said here Friday he is considering a third term as governor of the Bay State.
He was attending a North Carolina State University "Emerging Issues Forum" which focuses on economic policies for the future. He spoke on states competing in the global marketplace.
Weld, a Republican who has been a considered a possible contender in a future U.S. Presidential race, said the state term limit law would not apply to him because he is grandfathered.
Asked about any plans for a run for the presidency, Weld responded, "I am just trying to be the best governor I can be."
Weld unsuccessfully ran against incumbent U.S. Sen. John Kerry, a Democrat, in November.
